messages:
olivia (AE): Sync: HorizonOne wants a 10-day POC. Requirements: SAML (Okta), SCIM (delta + bulk), RBAC group->role mapping + attribute rules, per-tenant domain TXT proof, SCIM token rotation policy, and a short hosted vs dedicated note for procurement. Any blockers?

raj (SE): We support SAML 2.0 signed assertions, metadata upload, SP/IdP flows. Can map SAML attrs -> subject and roles claim.

raj (SE): SCIM: RFC7644 compliant. PATCH + If-Match (ETag) supported. Bulk endpoint for initial seed. Default rate limit 10 req/s tenant, scalable on Dedicated.

marta (Solutions): RBAC: map SCIM groups (externalId) to Redwood roles; attribute-based bindings supported (e.g., dept=infra -> role:infra-eng). Will provide sample mapping JSON.

dan (Security): Answers: CMK supported on Dedicated/Private. TLS 1.2+ required. Audit logs default 90 days, extendable. SCIM tokens stored encrypted and can be rotated or revoked via API.

olivia (AE): Procurement wants 2-sentence hosted vs dedicated blurb (SLA, CMK, isolation, pricing ballpark).

marta (Solutions): Draft: "Hosted eval: fastest to start, logical tenant isolation, usage-based pricing, limited CMK options and no SLA for eval. Dedicated: isolated compute/networking with VPC options, full CMK support, configurable rate limits and audit retention, SLA-backed availability; committed pricing typically starts ~$20k+/mo depending on throughput."

raj (SE): Sample SCIM PATCH with If-Match for their IdP team:

curl -X PATCH "https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users/42f" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  -H "If-Match: \"etag42\"" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],"Operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"active","value":false}]}'

infra-bot: Provisioned POC tenant 'horizonone-poc-2026' in us-east-1. Temporary creds DM'd to olivia.

olivia (AE): Kickoff Wed 9am PT. I'll ask HorizonOne to upload IdP metadata and a small CSV for seed. Dan/marta I'll DM the security questionnaire. Thanks all.
